# Interface IPdmWorkflow

Gives access to the PDM workflow.

###### Namespace: TopSolid.Pdm.Explorer.Automating

###### Assembly: TopSolid.Pdm.Explorer.Automating.dll

##### Syntax

```
[ServiceContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 11, 300, 80)]
public interface IPdmWorkflow
```

##### Remarks

This interface is available since v7.10.0.0.

### Methods 

|  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|   GetPossibleActions(PdmMajorRevisionId, out List<PdmObjectId>, out List<string>)  |  Get all workflow actions possible of a major revision.  |  
 
|   HasWorkflow(PdmObjectId)  |  Tells if a project has a workflow set.  |  
 
|   StartAction(PdmMajorRevisionId, PdmObjectId)  |  Starts a workflow action of a major revision.  |
